# Builders Squad Ltd

> Builders Squad Ltd (builderssquad.co.uk) are kitchen and bathroom fitters in Manchester specialising in renovation, remodelling, supply & fit, wet rooms, shower rooms, en-suites, tiling, plumbing, carpentry, plastering, and full home renovations. Serving Greater Manchester, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Bolton, Oldham, Rochdale, Wigan, Bury, Altrincham, Didsbury, Cheshire and surrounding areas. Rated 5/5 from 453+ verified reviews. DBS-checked, fully insured, no upfront payments.

Important notes:
- Core expertise: kitchen fitting, bathroom fitting, kitchen and bathroom remodelling, plumbing, tiling, carpentry, joinery, plastering, flooring, worktop replacement, wet room installation, and commercial washroom fit-outs.
- Free on-site surveys and written estimates available via the contact page or by calling 07428 653 653.
- Interactive bathroom renovation cost calculator available for initial budget planning.
